Select compound ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, activity standard type, relation, value, units, comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to require SMILES. Join docs on doc_id to obtain PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records on record_id to retrieve compound key. Filter for target CHEMBL4794, standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and presence of canonical SMILES. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, relation, value, units, activity comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism.
